specs.name: 清朗低束
specs.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Generate ONE complete new male portrait variant for this existing Chinese cultivation game.
The single reference is the CURRENT USER-APPROVED MALE MATERIAL AND ANCHOR MASTER. Every variant must match THIS reference's skin color, hair material/color, paint quality, same body framing and head/neck interface. The new portrait is one coherent whole illustration, never a component collage or a multi-person sheet.

STYLE AND COLOR LOCK: identical warm pale ivory-peach skin family to the reference, same color on face/ears/neck; preserve its gentle neutral-warm shadows and natural soft painted texture. Reference unobscured forehead roughlyRGB231/204/188, neck221/187/168, not a demand for flat fills. Do not bleach white, pink-shift, tan, orange-darken, add makeup, heavy creases, mottled patches or plastic sheen. Hair is the reference's dominant dark warm CHARCOAL-BLACK with soft very fine flowing strands and restrained thin warmgray highlights, matte natural ink masses, not silver, milkgray, metallic or glossy cables. Same delicate semi-realistic Chinese gongbi / softly washed ink painting and muted paper texture.

ONE handsome East Asian adult man age25–29, refined and naturally masculine, looking directly at viewer with a clear composed expression. Make an attractive new set of brows/eyes/nose/lips, while retaining the compatible skull, jaw, ears and neck outline. Balanced naturally small-to-medium MALE eyes, normal brown iris diameter partly covered by upper lids, subtle fine lid pigment, sparse short lashes. Do not enlarge or round the eyes or irises, add long lashes, eyeliner wings, thick cosmetic brows, pouty lips or a white nose stripe. Complete softly modeled nasal root, alae and nostrils, closed natural slim muted peach-brown lips. Face, skin, hair and clothes form one harmonious painting.

ANCHOR COMPOSITION: exact1024x1536 shared full portrait canvas. Straight frontal head and shoulders, balanced centerline aroundx513–514, no turn, tilt, perspective change or torso twist. Same head/neck size as the reference. Male eyes near(462,365)/(566,365), brows abouty343, nose around(517,444), lip center(516,477), chin around(513,544), central hairline near(514,268), ears abouty350–440. Rounded natural high skull, no inflated head or wig wings. Neck envelope at y530 x428–601,y550 x426–603,y580 x421–608, original collar roots around(433,545)/(599,545), inner V near(532,684), shoulder cornersabout(111,718)/(912,718), tied sasharoundy1250. Hairstyle may vary, but skull, face, eyes, jaw and neck do not get resized or repositioned. Guides are for composition only, never draw marks or text.

CLOTHING/BACKDROP: preserve the reference's deep muted jade-green robe, ivory inner crossed collar, pale muted gold botanical/cloud embroidery, soft folds and cloth sash. Keep its scale and silhouette; continuous natural head/neck/collar contact. Same plain warm ivory paper background, full portrait down to the tied waist, head and all upper hair inside frame. No weapons, jewelry, extra people, UI, labels, borders, grids or separate parts.

SPECIFIC VARIANT:
A quietly warm, scholarly handsome man with an open gentle gaze. Softly straight finely separated brows with a very gentle curved outer third; slightly softer almond-long eyes, natural low-to-moderate opening, calm alert pupils. A fine straight nose with softly rounded alae, relaxed slim lips with the faintest kind curve.
HAIR DESIGN: a genuinely LOW-TIED hairstyle gathered at the nape, no upper bun or top hairpin silhouette. A natural seven-to-three swept side part exposing most forehead; both temple masses tucked behind ears. The low tie produces one loose long tail BEHIND the shoulders, mostly gathered rather than a broad half-up curtain. Leave just ONE light naturally curved wisp on the image-left forehead, the other forehead side clean. No paired cheek-hanging curtains and no two long chest locks. Keep the front crown and skull restrained in the same existing head frame. Plain dark hair cord at the low tie, subtle and traditional. This silhouette and brow/eye character should be distinctly different from the reference's middle-parted half-up long hair.
